raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Background

Revert https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7859 in full, as requested.

## What changed

Reverts commit `b4407209223d290bbf7d6f2167d4e2ae51b7a58d`, restoring both `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` to their pre-#7859 contents.

## Details

- Restore `opentelemetry-api~=1.33.1` in the dev and LTS groups.
- Restore the previous setuptools constraints and remove the ModelOpt minimum added by #7859.
- Undo the full dependency lockfile upgrade included in #7859.

This restores the previous OpenTelemetry constraint, including the incompatibility with newer wandb versions described in #7859.

## Tested

- `git diff --cached --check` — passed before committing.
- `git diff --exit-code b4407209223d290bbf7d6f2167d4e2ae51b7a58d^ -- pyproject.toml uv.lock` — passed; both files exactly match the pre-#7859 versions.
- `docker run --rm -v /home/okoenig/Documents/Repositories/github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM-codex-worktrees/revert-pr-7859:/workspace -w /workspace gitlab-master.nvidia.com/adlr/megatron-lm/mcore_ci_dev:70313323-amd64 uv lock --check --offline` — passed; resolved 328 packages.
